review:
Chests of Cai Shen – Infinity is a respin game where the base game is mainly a route into the feature. Green, blue, purple, red and quad coins land and are collected by chests above the grid, and any of them can randomly trigger the bonus with three respins and up to four modifiers.

Green raises three money symbols, blue adds four multiplier zones worth up to 100x, purple adds a respin and red plays the round on two 5×3 grids. A quad coin can switch several on at once. Money symbols up to 150x stick and reset the respins, and filling every position adds a 5,000x prize. Published RTP is 96.50%. It suits fans of hold-and-win style collecting.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
